name: Watashi no Namae o Yobi Nasai!
original_name: 私の名前を呼びなさい!
source:
An exploration and search game in which a girl is placed under house arrest by a [i]denpa[/i] man, and tries to escape without getting caught and punished.

[Edited from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26267]Freem![/url]]
